rationale: C07 is a near-direct predecessor and plausibly supplied the material drafting template. It uses the same Senate committee, the same investigation of the Internal Security Act of 1950 and other internal-security laws, and essentially the same complete operative sequence. The child principally updates the tax years, Congress, Senate resolution, approval phrasing, and tax-category list. C11 is an older instance of the same specific template. C04 closely matches the child’s current-period tax-return and Treasury-compliance language but adapts it to a different committee and investigation.
